title: 皐月賞の後に・駆け込みの大舞台

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff… This is… all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even if I didn't have any flashy moments that set me apart, I was still able to push myself to my limits!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. Successfully finishing the Satsuki Sho has made my heart feel so full.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I wasn't sure if I'd be okay going in, though. Um… Sorry for all the trouble I caused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Things had been a little dicey before the race started, thanks to that unexpected plot twist that hit us…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: OHHH NOOO! Trainer, Trainer! I… I—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I forgot to submit my paperwork for entering the Satsuki Sho! Since I wasn't going to run it at first, I totally forgot about it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Whaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh well! That's no biggie, is it? What's a little bit of paperwork anyway? Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It is a biggie! I can't run in the race if I don't submit my paperwork!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I caused you so much stress and grief because of my carelessness…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, we meet up with Sakura Bakushin O so we can head home together, but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What's this? Look over there, where all the reporters are. I recognize that Uma they're surrounding…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! What will Brusquement's plans be next? Will you be going straight for the Derby next? Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Astute Trainer
text_block_list.text: Nothing is set in stone yet, but it's highly likely that we'll be running in the Derby next. At least, that is the plan for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A throng of reporters bustles around Brusquement. Despite how well Kitasan Black ran today, everyone's attention is on her rival.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I'm still not good enough for anyone to notice me…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chin up! Don't let this eat at you! The Classic Triple Crown's barely even started!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This is no time to turn your eyes away from the finish line! Keep your head up and keep heading toward tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIN! BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right! Bakushin, Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's pep talk pulls Kitasan Black out from the dumps. For now, I just want her to make it out of this tunnel without stopping.
